subject.title: fix(node): cancellation and local inference fail under stress

question: Should this PR wait for host-side cancellation support for Mac app execution-host commands, or should its cancellation scope and user-impact claim be explicitly narrowed?
rationale: The needed repair crosses the node-host-to-Mac-app execution boundary, and the available diff does not establish whether that protocol already has a supported cancellation mechanism or requires an owner-approved extension.

options.title: Add host-side cancellation
options.body: Propagate cancellation into the Mac app execution-host protocol and prove that a launched command tree terminates after disconnect or cancellation.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Keep the local process-tree fix only and revise scope, tests, and user-impact claims so Mac app-hosted execution is not presented as cancellable.

recommendation.title: Add host-side cancellation
recommendation.body: Propagate cancellation into the Mac app execution-host protocol and prove that a launched command tree terminates after disconnect or cancellation.

likelyOwner.reason: This account authored the current cross-surface repair, but feature-history ownership could not be independently established in the read-only environment.
